lede: Mirai Auto Performance is a car repair workshop at 69 Loyang Dr. Its Google Maps listing shows opening hours and customer ratings.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention easy appointment booking, servicing done in about an hour, a 36-point checklist, a comfortable lounge while waiting, and spark plug and intake decarbonisation work after warning lights came on.
